The "Oversigt over alle indikatorer" (Overview of all indicators) provides a structured framework for evaluating the clinical quality of acute surgery, detailing ten specific metrics used to monitor patient care pathways and final health outcomes [^src1]. These metrics are divided into two distinct categories: process indicators, which track adherence to clinical protocols and treatment timelines, and outcome indicators, which measure final patient results such as mortality rates [^src1]. All ten indicators are measured as a proportion (Andel) of the relevant patient population [^src1].

When examining the national standards set for these metrics, the strictest targets for process indicators are set at ≥ 90%, applying to [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] (CT scanning within 120 minutes of arrival), [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (preoperative optimization or direct to surgery), and [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] (mobilization within 24 hours post-surgery) [^src1]. Conversely, the most lenient process targets are set at > 60%, which apply to [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] (antibiotic treatment within 3 hours of arrival) and [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] (epidural placement during surgery) [^src1]. Intermediate process targets of ≥ 80% are established for [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] (surgery within 6 hours for those operated within 24 hours) and [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] (postoperative monitoring for elderly or severely ill patients) [^src1]. The outcome indicators, [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] and [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]], focus on mortality, setting maximum acceptable thresholds of < 12% for 30-day mortality and < 18% for 90-day mortality [^src1]. 

A notable outlier in this framework is [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]], which tracks the proportion of patients resuming nutrition within 48 hours post-surgery; unlike the other nine indicators, it does not have a defined national standard or target value listed in this overview [^src1]. Furthermore, because this document represents a single snapshot of the 2024 indicator definitions, no longitudinal trends regarding target adjustments or actual performance improvements can be derived from this isolated table [^src1]. The data outlines the required standards rather than actual performance, meaning it establishes the targets to be met rather than showing who currently meets or misses them [^src1].

The broader context, regional performance data, and detailed methodological descriptions for these indicators are distributed throughout the 2023 and 2024 annual reports. The 2023 report covers extensive evaluations of regional adherence and clinical outcomes across multiple sections [^src4] [^src8] [^src9] [^src19] [^src2] [^src10] [^src7] [^src20]. Similarly, the 2024 report provides updated national and regional analyses, methodology, and appendices detailing the ongoing monitoring of acute surgery quality [^src12] [^src5] [^src13] [^src21] [^src17] [^src14] [^src3] [^src6] [^src11] [^src15] [^src16] [^src18] [^src22].

- "Regionalt varierede andelen af patienter, der fik antibiotika indenfor tre timer efter ankomst til sygehus fra 22,5 % i Region Syddanmark til 44,6 % i Region Midtjylland" — see [[regional-comparison|Regional Comparison]] ([[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]) [^src5]
- "Regionalt varierede andelen af intermediær indlæggelse fra 17,2 % i Region Nordjylland til 27,0 % i Region Syddanmark" — see [[regional-comparison|Regional Comparison]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src17]
- "Regionalt varierede andelen fra 6,8 % i Region Nordjylland til 33,1 % i Region Hovedstaden" — see [[regional-comparison|Regional Comparison]] ([[indikator-7|Indikator 7]]) [^src3]
- "Regionalt varierede andelen fra 41,9 % i Region Nordjylland til 56,8 % i Region Syddanmark" — see [[regional-variation|Regional Variation]] ([[indikator-8|Indikator 8]]) [^src6]
- "Udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 % var således ikke opnået" — see [[evaluation|Evaluation]] ([[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]) [^src13]
- "Det anbefales at alle patienter med mistanke om tarm iskæmi, perforeret hulorgan eller ileus gennemgår CT scanning med kontrast så hurtigt som muligt i deres indlæggelsesforløb" — see [[recommendation|Recommendation]] ([[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]) [^src13]
- "CT-scanning bør startes indenfor 2 timer da vi ønsker at disse patienter opereres indenfor 6 timer efter indlæggelse" — see [[recommendation|Recommendation]] ([[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]) [^src13]
- "Udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 % er således langt fra opfyldt" — see [[evaluative|Evaluative]] ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src21]
- "Ingen af de indberettende enheder opfyldte udviklingsmålet" — see [[evaluative|Evaluative]] ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src21]
- "Andelen af patienter med høj mortalitetsrisiko (ASA ≥ 3 eller alder ≥ 75 år), der monitoreres ≥ 24 timer postoperativt på et intermediært eller lignende afsnit, er 22,9 % (95 % CI: 21,1–24,8)" — see [[clinical-quality|Clinical Quality]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src17]
- "P-POSSUM og APACHE vurderes som for omfattende til praktisk brug i forbindelse med Indikator 5" — see [[methodological-assessment|Methodological Assessment]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src17]
- "Surgical Apgar Score ekskluderer risikopatienter, der ikke er fysiologisk stressede peroperativt" — see [[methodological-assessment|Methodological Assessment]] ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src17]
- "Nationalt var andelen af patienter, der døde indenfor 90 dage fra operationsdato, 16,6 % (95 % CI: 15,4–18,0) i perioden 01.09.2023 – 31.08.2024" — see [[clinical-outcome|Clinical Outcome]] ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]) [^src11]
- "For Indikator 10 var antallet af døde patienter 529 ud af 3.179 forløb på nationalt plan" — see [[clinical-outcome|Clinical Outcome]] ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]) [^src11]
- "Der indgik 3.179 forløb i indikatoranalysen i perioden. Heraf døde 376 personer, svarende til 11,8 % (95 % CI: 10,7-13,0) indenfor 30 dage fra ankomst til sygehus" — see [[outcome|Outcome]] ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]) [^src16]
- "Der indgik 3.179 patienter i indikatoranalysen i perioden. Heraf døde 529 personer, svarende til 16,6 % indenfor 90 dage fra ankomst til sygehus" — see [[outcome|Outcome]] ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]) [^src16]
